lore.item.lost_aether_content.orange_moa: Un huevo puesto por un Moa Naranja. El huevo es sorprendentemente ligero. Cuando es incubado produce un Moa Naranja con 2 saltos en mitad del aire. Este Moa tiene una habilidad especial que le permite acelerar gradualmente mientras se mueve en una sola dirección. Moverse lateralmente no afecta su velocidad directamente, pero si que hace que acelere más lentamente. Girar reduce su velocidad. Mientras esta en el suelo, gana velocidad mucho más lentamente de lo que lo haría en el aire.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.brown_moa_: Un huevo marrón misterioso de un Moa que no se encuentra en estado salvaje. Si un Moa Azul y un Moa Naranja están cerca el uno del otro, se puede observar como ponen estos huevos. Eclosionar estos huevos otorga un Moa Marrón con una velocidad decente, y 3 saltos en mitad del aire, los cuales son más fuertes de lo normal. Estos Moas también son inmunes a los efectos de embriaguez. Cuando han crecido, los Moas Marrones puedes poner estos huevos, como sería de esperar.
lore.block.lost_aether_content.crystal_s: Estos brotes azules creceran en Árboles de Cristal Frutales. Su crecimiento puede ser acelerado con Polvo de Hueso.
lore.block.lost_aether_content.holiday_s: A festive purple sapling. It will grow into a large holiday tree. They can be grown faster with Bone Meal.
lore.block.lost_aether_content.gale_ston: A cool, blue stone that makes up most of the Platinum Dungeon's structure. It cannot be destroyed until the Aerwhale King is defeated.
lore.block.lost_aether_content.gale_slab: Crafted from Gale Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building's roofing!
lore.block.lost_aether_content.gale_stai: Crafted from Gale Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
lore.block.lost_aether_content.gale_wall: Crafted from Gale Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
lore.block.lost_aether_content.light_gal: The glowing version of Gale Stone. It can be found in the Platinum Dungeon along with Gale stone. Likewise, it cannot be collected until the boss is defeated.
lore.block.lost_aether_content.songstone: The sound this legendary stone makes can only be heard fully by the Aerwhale King. The sound keeps his mind in a tranquil state. If activated, he will prepare for battle.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.platinum_k: A super shiny key awarded by the Aerwhale King after being defeated. You can use it to claim the treasure on the second floor of the dungeon!
lore.item.lost_aether_content.flaming_ge: This gemstone is hot to the touch, when the wearer is attacked, the attacker is set on fire for 3 seconds.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.invincibil: A stone that has a chance to allow the wearer dodge a blow, concealing them, possibly helping them to escape a rough situation.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.power_glov: These gloves increase force behind the wearers punches. When using them to punch, they knock enemies much farther back than usual.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.sentry_shi: This shield seems to be ancient sentry technology. It grants the wearer immunity to explosions. It also has a chance to detonate when attacked. Both of these things damage the shield.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.swetty_mas: What looks to be the body of a Swet. Other than its aesthetic appearance, it can be used to negate crash damage while using an Elytra.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.agility_bo: A rare pair of boots found in the Platinum Dungeon. They're very light and aerodynamic, allowing for faster movement.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.phoenix_ca: A warm cloak. It has the power to give the wearer a second chance at life, should they get close to falling into the void.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.phoenix_sw: A heavy, molten sword which burns its foes to a crisp. It almost hurts to touch! Using this on animals can make them drop cooked meat!
lore.item.lost_aether_content.phoenix_pi: The metal of this pickaxe is molten hot, it melts through stone, allowing the smelting of ores instantly.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.phoenix_ax: The head of this axe is molten hot, it melts through wood, it chars wood on contact.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.phoenix_sh: The head of this shovel is molten hot, it smelts sand, and similar blocks when touched.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.phoenix_ho: A scorching hot metal hoe. It has the ability to till dirt, and cook crops when harvested.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.zanite_shi: A shield made completely of Zanite used to block attacks. It doesn't seem to have any special quirks. Regardless of that, it is more durable than the typical wooden shield.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.gravitite_: Un escudo hecho completamente de Gravitita. Puede ser usado para bloquear ataques. Causa mucho más retroceso cuando algo lo ataca.
lore.item.lost_aether_content.shield_of_: A shield that's said to have been used along with the Hammer of Kingbdogz. It has some scratches on it. It reflects blocked projectiles as if they were yours!
lore.block.lost_aether_content.pink_aerc: Una nube rosa increiblemente suave. Tiene propiedades curativas naturales, sin embargo solo pueden ser utilizadas a través de encantamientos.
lore.block.lost_aether_content.enchanted: Una nube rosa increiblemente suave. El estar encantada permite que sus propiedades curativas naturales se activen, curando las heridas de cualquiera cuando descansan en ella.
